Restaurant demo sites (x9)

Live (demo)

Developer

Nine static restaurant sites driven by one JSON file per page, with an in-browser cart.

A set of nine static restaurant sites built from a shared template, each page driven by its own JSON file, with a browser-side cart. A good example of data-driven templating at volume, where content is editable without touching the layout.

Stack

  • Astro
  • JSON-driven
  • Static
